packageOverrides.name: api-gouv-publique-fr
packageOverrides.summary: Typed client for French public APIs: company search by SIREN or SIRET, address search and the Geo API, with a Laravel bridge, validation rules and test fakes.

packageOverrides.name: data-lifecycle
packageOverrides.summary: Keep personal data only as long as needed (GDPR): warn before expiry, disable with a grace period, then anonymise or delete.

packageOverrides.name: slug-history
packageOverrides.summary: Keep old URLs working when a slug changes: past slugs are remembered and answered with a 301.

packageOverrides.name: unaccent-search
packageOverrides.summary: Accent and case insensitive SQL search, without a database extension (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite).

packageOverrides.name: laravel-keycloak-sanctum
packageOverrides.summary: Keycloak SSO for a SPA backed by a Laravel API: Sanctum token, roles, back-channel logout and idle timeout.

packageOverrides.name: keycloak-sanctum-vue
packageOverrides.summary: Vue 3 client for laravel-keycloak-sanctum: user, roles, router guard, authenticated fetch and inactivity logout.

packageOverrides.name: prepare-image
packageOverrides.summary: Prepare a user-picked photo for upload: decode HEIC, apply camera orientation, resize and strip GPS location.
